selection_reasoning: I selected 'find iron_bars' and 'find campfire' as two navigation/exploration tasks that can form a coherent multi-hop dependency. The idea is that the player must first locate iron bars (which could be part of a jail cell or window structure), and then from that location, navigate to find a campfire. The iron bars serve as a landmark or waypoint that guides the player toward the campfire area. This creates a natural spatial dependency where finding the first structure helps orient the player to find the second. Both tasks are observable (iron bars and campfires are visually distinct blocks), verifiable, and require no deep crafting knowledge — just spatial navigation and visual recognition.

edges.reason: Iron bars mark a structure (jail/building) whose interior or adjacent area contains the campfire; finding iron bars first orients the player toward the campfire location

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The player must walk forward toward the cobblestone building and get close to the iron bars window in the front wall at spawn-relative [0, 2, 6]. max_distance=5 prevents auto-triggering at spawn (player starts ~6.3 blocks away), requiring at least 1-2 blocks of forward movement. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the iron bars.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The player must navigate around the cobblestone building to locate the campfire behind it at spawn-relative [0, 1, 9]. The building (walls at Z+6 and Z+7) physically blocks direct line-of-sight and walking path from spawn, requiring the player to walk around either side. max_distance=8 ensures the player has navigated close enough (spawn is ~9.06 blocks away, so won't auto-trigger). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the campfire.

scene_description: A cobblestone building with iron bars in the front window, placed on cleared grass. A campfire sits behind the building, requiring the player to navigate around the structure. Torches flank the building entrance, and a stone brick path leads from spawn to the front wall.
task_text: Find the iron bars in the front of the building, then navigate around the building to find the campfire behind it.
design_notes: Building front wall at Z+6, back wall at Z+7 (with opening). Iron bars at [~-1 to ~1, Y+2 to Y+3, Z+6]. Campfire at [~0, Y+1, Z+9] — 2 blocks behind back wall. Cleared 16×17 area removes jungle trees for navigation. Stone brick path from Z+4 to Z+5 guides player forward. Torches at ±4 blocks from building center provide visual anchoring.
